startStoryMapDesc: Describe your story in a sentence or two. Then expand it — premise into acts, acts into chapters, chapters into scenes — each level graphically connected to the last.
premisePlaceholder: A lighthouse keeper discovers the ships she guides ashore arrive from a century in the past…

tour.premiseBody: One sentence is enough — it becomes the root node of your story map, ready to expand.
tour.expandBody: The sparkle button breaks an element into the next level — premise into acts, acts into chapters, chapters into scenes. Add optional guidance to steer it.
tour.elementsBody: Acts, scenes, beats, characters, locations, and lore — drop them anywhere and connect them by dragging between node handles.

expand.title: Expand “{{label}}”
expand.desc: AI breaks this element into the next level of your story, connected on the canvas.
expand.placeholder: Steer the expansion — e.g. “darker tone, five chapters, end on a betrayal”
expand.hint: Press Enter to expand, Shift+Enter for a new line.

panel.configureDetails: Configure the details for this story element
panel.noCharactersYet: No characters yet — add some in the Codex first.
panel.title: Title
panel.goalsPlaceholder: What does the character want to achieve in this part?
panel.conflictPlaceholder: What obstacles, challenges, or tensions arise?
panel.notesPlaceholder: Additional notes, inspiration, and creative ideas...
panel.noConnections: No connections yet. Drag from a node's bottom handle to another node's top handle to link them — connections feed AI draft generation.
panel.sendToWriter: Send this chapter to the Write editor
panel.deleteDialogDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{label}}"? This will permanently remove the story element and all its connections. This action cannot be undone.

writingPanel.generateDesc: Uses this element's connected characters, settings, lore, plot threads, and preceding story elements as context, plus any existing text below.
writingPanel.instructionsPlaceholder: Optional instructions, e.g. 'tense pacing, end on a reveal'
writingPanel.noWritingYet: No writing yet. Generate a draft above or add a block below.
writingPanel.writeContentPlaceholder: Write content for this story element...
